name: Cleaning Up Your Life
overview: Scripture reveals that true cleansing and transformation in life come through the Word of God and faith in Jesus Christ, who is the way, the truth, and the life. Jesus assures believers that they are made clean by His words and that by hearing and believing in Him, they pass from death to life and avoid condemnation. The call to watch and pray continually underscores the necessity of spiritual vigilance to stand worthy before the Son of Man, while God's promises are sure and will be fulfilled in His timing.
